_comment: Drives territory_report.py. Each entry says which real-world 'state' values map to which territory/*.json hierarchy file. Add/remove states here without touching code.
_unmatched_label: 'unmatched_label' is used when a row's state matches one of these groups but its city can't be found anywhere in that group's territory file (new/renamed towns, typos, etc). Those rows still get counted, just bucketed separately so totals never silently drop rows.
_label_overrides: Renames a territory/*.json bucket label for display, without editing the hierarchy file itself (which encodes city->territory classification, not naming). Key = the label as it appears in the territory/*.json file; value = what to display instead everywhere (territories list, groups, territory_order should use the new name).
